name: Push
description: Push is a game mode introduced in Overwatch 2 where two teams fight for control of a TS-1 robot that moves a barricade along a set track. Controlling the robot pushes the barricade toward the enemy spawn, and the team that pushes it farthest within the time limit wins, with an instant win if a barricade reaches the end of the track.

respawn_mechanics.forward_spawn_revert_condition: Opposing team pushes the robot back to the starting point at the middle

instant_win_conditions.condition_description: If a team manages to push the barricade all the way to the end, the match ends instantly in their victory.
If the losing team loses control of the robot during overtime, the match immediately ends.
If the losing team pushes the robot past the other team's best distance during overtime, they immediately win.

overtime_rules.trigger_condition: The team with less distance pushed is controlling or contesting the robot when the match timer expires
overtime_rules.resolution_condition: Match ends if the losing team loses control, or the losing team wins immediately if they push the robot past the other team's best distance

trivia: If you say hello to the robot, he will either say "Hello!" or "Greetings!" Using Juno's Hyper Ring and Lucio's speed boost do not affect the speed of the robot.
